hypothesis: Instruction count is dominated by fixed transformer overhead plus work proportional to text length, with an additional cost when the scheduler initializes its step index.

pcvs.name: text_length
pcvs.rationale: Tracks text projection and cross-attention work in both transformer calls; latent dimensions and model size are fixed.

pcvs.name: scheduler_initialization
pcvs.rationale: Captures scheduler initialization performed on the first denoising step of each pipeline call.
